references.text: The same introductory formula is used repeatedly in Numbers when the Lord gives instructions to Moses.
The preceding context that led to God giving instructions about the staffs - the rebellion of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.
Another example of the typical revelation formula where the Lord speaks to Moses.
A parallel introductory formula where the Lord calls Moses and speaks to him.
God confirms Moses' unique position as the one the Lord speaks to directly, relevant to the context about leadership.
